variables.name: non_european_entrants_count

variables.name: israel_participates
variables.description: Binary: Israel takes part in and reaches the Eurovision 2026 Grand Final (1) or is absent/withdrawn/excluded/fails to qualify (0).

variables.name: best_nonEU_bookmaker_odds
variables.description: Implied win probability of the highest-ranked of the four non-European entries in bookmaker/odds aggregators (eurovisionworld) on the day of the final, in percent (0-100).

variables.name: televote_bloc_boost
variables.description: Latent intensity hub: strength of geopolitically-driven televote surges favouring non-European entrants. 0 = recent-normal year (Israel ~ top-3 televote), 1 = recent-high (2024/2025-style televote landslide for Israel), 2 = severe regime (record televote margin plus jury shift), 3 = extreme/record regime.

variables.name: voting_rule_change_shock
variables.description: Binary: EBU implements a rule change before/at the 2026 contest (e.g. capped televote, restricted multiple voting, jury reweighting) explicitly aimed at limiting diaspora/campaign televoting.

variables.name: boycott_or_exclusion_shock
variables.description: Binary: a major boycott wave or EBU decision materially alters the 2026 field (multiple broadcasters withdraw or a participant is excluded) before the final.

variables.name: unlisted_shock
